title: anthyllis vulneraria subsp. vitellina
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria subsp. vitellina, commonly known as kidney vetch or yellow lucerne, is a flowering plant in the legume family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to soothe digestive issues and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Anthyllis vulneraria subsp. vitellina include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
